# Elan Sports

> > Slovenian ski manufacturer since 1945, crafting award-winning skis including Ripstick, ACE, Wingman, Playmaker, and the revolutionary Voyager folding ski.

Elan Sports produces premium skis handcrafted in Begunje na Gorenjskem in the Slovenian Alps, featuring innovative technologies like Carbon Bridge Technology, Connect Technology, and Fusion X binding systems. The company operates W Studio, a women's ski development program, and serves both resort and backcountry skiing markets worldwide.

## Signature Ski Lines

- [Ripstick – Elan Sports](https://elansports.com/en-us/pages/ripstick): Lightweight all-mountain ski line for resort and backcountry
- [Ripstick Tour – Elan Sports](https://elansports.com/pages/ripstick-tour): Glen Plake signature backcountry ski with Carbon Bridge Technology
- [Voyager - FOLDING TRAVEL SKI – Elan Sports](https://elansports.com/voyager-101): Revolutionary folding all-mountain ski with Connect Technology
- [Playmaker – Elan Sports](https://elansports.com/en-us/pages/playmaker): Freestyle-freeride hybrid ski handcrafted in Slovenian Alps
- [PRIMETIME 33 – Elan Sports](https://elansports.com/primetime-33-abdklk23): Carving ski with Mono Ti Reinforcement and Fusion X binding system
